No text of any kind inside the illustrated scene. CRITICAL COMPOSITION RULE: a rectangular zone at the top centre of the image, 32 percent of the image width, centred horizontally, running from the top edge down to 32 percent of the image height, must contain ONLY quiet empty background such as a plain wall, a bright window, or soft out-of-focus foliage. This zone is reserved for a logo that is composited afterward. Across the middle of the image, a smooth deep teal #0E303A curved wave sweeps from the left edge to the right edge, dividing the illustration above from a clean cream #F6F2E9 lower area below. Beneath the ribbon, a large centred dark navy #0E303A bold serif headline on two lines that reads exactly Small Routines Help Children Settle. Below the headline, a row of three evenly spaced circular pale aqua #A9D3DD badges, each containing a simple dark navy #0E303A line icon and each with two short lines of small dark grey #3F3D38 caption text centred directly beneath it. At the very bottom of the image, a solid deep teal #0E303A horizontal footer bar running the full width, containing centred white uppercase letter-spaced text that reads exactly BOKLAWFIRM.COM.
